Lower Treasury yields leave Bitcoin's demand question open


https://
capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/lower-treasu
ry-yields-leave-bitcoins
…

U.S. Department of the Treasury's 10-year yield fell to 4.90% on November 4.

Lower interest elsewhere can help Bitcoin's case; it does not establish that buyers are returning.

Watch: For Bitcoin, the useful distinction is between a lower return on an interest-bearing alternative and evidence that investors want more exposure to a volatile asset.

Analysis, not financial advice.
